items.title: 2.9 Elastic collision in two dimensions (do dimensions mein elastic takkar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.9 with Fig. 2.15 and Example 2.9 (PDF 44-45, 49-50; printed 41-42, 46-47).

blocks.text: Jab ek axis ke saath chalti do bodies collision ke baad usi pehli axis par nahi chaltin, to yeh two-dimensional collision hai. Agar collision elastic ho to bodies ka system apna total linear momentum aur total kinetic energy dono conserved (qaim) rakhta hai.

Do bodies lein jo ek glancing (tirchhe, chhoo kar guzarne wale) angle par elastic collision karti hain, yani head-on (seedhi aamne saamne) takkar nahi. Pehli body (projectile) ka mass m₁ hai aur initial velocity v⃗₁i; doosri body (target) ka mass m₂ hai aur woh shuru mein ruki hui hai, v⃗₂i = 0. Collision par dono ke darmiyan impulses paida hote hain jo unhen x-axis (jis par projectile pehle chal raha tha) se θ₁ aur θ₂ angles par bhej dete hain (Fig. 2.15).

blocks.alt: x aur y axes; ball m₂ origin par ruki hui hai. Ball m₁ baen taraf se x-axis ke saath velocity v₁ᵢ se aati hai. Collision ke baad m₂ x-axis se oopar angle θ₂ par velocity v₂f se, aur m₁ x-axis se neeche angle θ₁ par velocity v₁f se chali jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.15: Two dimensions mein elastic collision (kitab ki Figure 2.15 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Yani glancing collision woh elastic collision hai jo do bodies ke darmiyan head-on (seedha) na ho.
Shuru mein mass m₂ wali body (target) ruki hui hai.

Collision se pehle projectile ka momentum m₁v⃗₁i hai aur target ka momentum zero. Collision ke baad projectile (mass m₁, velocity v⃗₁f) ka momentum m₁v⃗₁f hai aur target (mass m₂, velocity v⃗₂f) ka m₂v⃗₂f. Projectile ke final momentum ke components m₁v⃗₁f cos θ₁ aur m₁v⃗₁f sin θ₁ hain; isi tarah target ke components m₂v⃗₂f cos θ₂ aur m₂v⃗₂f sin θ₂.

blocks.text_alt: Momentum before collision = Momentum after collision
m₁v₁i = m₁v₁f cos θ₁ + m₂v₂f cos θ₂
m₁v₁i - m₁v₁f cos θ₁ = m₂v₂f cos θ₂   (2.34)

blocks.text: y-axis ke saath momentum conservation (shuru mein y-momentum zero tha; ek body oopar aur doosri neeche jati hai, is liye minus):

blocks.text_alt: Momentum before collision = Momentum after collision
0 = m₁v₁f sin θ₁ - m₂v₂f sin θ₂
m₁v₁f sin θ₁ = m₂v₂f sin θ₂   (2.35)

blocks.text: Elastic collision mein kinetic energy bhi conserved rehti hai; ½ dono taraf se kat jata hai:

In equations mein chaar unknown (na-maloom) quantities hain: v⃗₁f, v⃗₂f, θ₁ aur θ₂. Agar inhen measure kar (naap) liya jaye to equations (2.34), (2.35) aur (2.36) se momentum aur energy ka conservation prove (sabit) kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Inelastic collision mein kinetic energy ka kuch hissa heat (garmi), sound (awaz) aur deformation (shakal bigarna) mein chala jata hai. Example: lakri ke block mein bullet (goli) maari jaye to collision inelastic hai, kyun ke bullet ki kuch energy sound aur heat ban jati hai. Isi tarah kisi height se farsh par giri ball usi height tak wapas nahi uchhalti, kyun ke us ki kuch kinetic energy sound aur heat ban jati hai.

blocks.title: Example 2.9
blocks.problem: 1 kg mass ka particle (zarra) 'A' 5 m s⁻¹ ki initial velocity se right taraf chal kar usi mass ke ruke hue target 'B' se takrata hai. Collision ke baad 'A' horizontal se 30° oopar 3 m s⁻¹ ki speed se aur 'B' horizontal se 53° par 4 m s⁻¹ ki speed se chalta hai. Prove karein ke collision elastic hai. (Kitab mein yeh example topic 2.12 ke baad chhapa hai.)
steps: Pehle ka momentum: m₁v₁i + m₂v₂i = (1 kg × 5 m s⁻¹) + (1 kg × 0) = 5 kg m s⁻¹
Baad ka x-momentum: (1 kg × 3 m s⁻¹ × cos 30°) + (1 kg × 4 m s⁻¹ × cos 53°) = 2.60 + 2.40 = 5 kg m s⁻¹; x-direction mein momentum conserved hai.
Pehle ki K.E.: ½ × 1 × (5)² + ½ × 1 × 0 = 12.5 J
blocks.answer: Momentum (x-direction mein) aur K.E. dono conserved hain, is liye collision elastic hai.

blocks.caption: Glancing elastic collision ki teen equations
rows: m₁v₁i = m₁v₁f cos θ₁ + m₂v₂f cos θ₂
m₁v₁f sin θ₁ = m₂v₂f sin θ₂

blocks.prompt: Example 2.9 mein y-axis ke saath bhi momentum check karein. Yeh bhi batayein ke kinetic energy ko components mein torne ki zaroorat kyun nahi pari.
blocks.explanation: Baad ka y-momentum: 1 × 3 × sin 30° - 1 × 4 × sin 53° = 1.50 - 3.19 = -1.7 kg m s⁻¹, jo zero nahi. Yani kitab ke diye angles ke saath y-momentum conserved nahi hota; kitab ka solution sirf x-momentum aur energy check karta hai. (Barabar mass ke elastic collision mein dono raste aapas mein 90° par hote hain; 3 m s⁻¹ aur 4 m s⁻¹ ki speeds ke liye angles taqreeban 53° aur 37° bante.) Kinetic energy scalar hai, is liye ½mv² mein seedhi speed lagti hai, components ki zaroorat nahi.

items: Glancing elastic collision, target ruka hua: x-momentum m₁v₁i = m₁v₁f cos θ₁ + m₂v₂f cos θ₂; y-momentum m₁v₁f sin θ₁ = m₂v₂f sin θ₂; energy m₁v₁i² = m₁v₁f² + m₂v₂f²; chaar unknowns: v₁f, v₂f, θ₁, θ₂.
